inputs: the harvest a receipt's run_dir names (exports/0001.gcode, proof/0001.3mf, setup.json), read-only

rules.leaf: every stage line except field.<X>, which wraps locate.<X> and edit_readback.<X>; a parent is never added to its children
rules.difference: candidate run minus the mean of the runs it is compared with (same machine, scenario and build line); K2 against K1

measures.process: process.json 起止之差（收据 seconds.guest）
measures.host_wall: summary.json host_wall_seconds，含收割；只有客机写
measures.orchestration: 台账 process_seconds；客机是 native_save_demo.py 进程，fa706g3 是投递到收割完成（含 10 秒轮询）
measures.leaf_sum: ok=1 且不是父段的阶段行之和

rules.caps: fa706g3 and the Mac count SHADOW at most (README rule 6); the guest is the regression-evidence machine
rules.signature: gcode_signature.py: length per (TYPE section, layer, feed) and filament per (TYPE section, layer), tolerance 0.05 mm
